test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**seamlessly**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage talks about the ease and efficiency of connecting with others globally through the internet.
 
• The appropriate adverb should suggest smoothness and efficiency in the process of connecting.
 
• "**Seamlessly**" (बिना किसी अवरोध के) fits well as it denotes smooth and uninterrupted connection, aligning with the context of internet use.
 
• Other options ("**hesitantly**", "**periodically**", "**scarcely**") do not adequately capture the idea of effortless and smooth connectivity described.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The internet has significantly__ reshaped the way information is accessed and shared. With a vast array of websites and social media platforms, individuals can *__*seamlessly*__* connect with others globally. However, this digital age also brings (3) __________ challenges. The spread of misinformation has become a (4) __________ issue, as false content can quickly gain traction. It is essential for users to (5) __________ assess the credibility of sources before believing and sharing information. In this era of rapid data dissemination, cultivating media literacy is of utmost importance.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hesitantly **(हिचकिचाहट से): "Hesitantly" means in an unsure or cautious manner, which does not fit the context of smooth and efficient connectivity.
 
• **Periodically **(समय समय पर): "Periodically" means at regular intervals, which does not capture the sense of continuous ease in connecting.
 
• **Scarcely **(कभी कभी): "Scarcely" means barely or hardly, which does not align with the idea of frequent and smooth global connections through the internet.
